title: netns missing default route causing containers not able to access internet
body:
### Issue Description

Disclaimer: LLM is used to find the root cause and workaround, but this issue is 100% hand written by me

I have a Linux machine (Fedora 44, Podman 5.8.9) with wireguard setup. When startup, it get the IPv6 address first, then it reach `network-online.target`, before it get the IPv4 from DHCPv4. When `network-online.target is reached` -> quadlet container is started -> netns is created by pasta using the wg0 interface which doesn't have a IPv4 default route. The logic is from `man pasta`:

```
-i, --interface name
              Use  host  interface  name to derive addresses and routes.  Default is to use the interfaces specified by --outbound-if4
              and --outbound-if6, for IPv4 and IPv6 addresses and routes, respectively.

              If no interfaces are given, the interface with the first default routes for each IP version is selected. If  no  default
              routes  are  available and there is just one interface with any route, that interface will be chosen instead. If no such
              interface exists, host interfaces will be ignored for the purposes of assigning addresses and routes, and link-local ad‐
              dresses will be used instead.
```

Without default route, the container can't access internet or `host.containers.internal`.

Relevant logs:
```
echo "boot:  $(uptime -s)"
echo "netns: $(stat -c '%w' /run/user/1000/containers/networks/rootless-netns/rootless-netns)"
echo "pasta: $(ps -eo lstart,comm | grep pasta | cut -c1-25)"
sudo journalctl -b -o short-precise -u NetworkManager --no-pager | grep -iE 'enp2s0' | grep -iE 'dhcp4|carrier|activated' | head
```
```
boot:  2026-11-16 21:22:09
netns: 2026-11-16 21:22:24.225185974 +0800
pasta: Mon Nov 16 21:22:23 2026 
Nov 16 21:22:20.344727 * NetworkManager[800]: <info>  [1794835340.3445] device (enp2s0): carrier: link connected
Nov 16 21:22:20.345497 * NetworkManager[800]: <info>  [1794835340.3454] device (enp2s0): state change: unavailable -> disconnected (reason 'carrier-changed', managed-type: 'full')
Nov 16 21:22:20.407886 * NetworkManager[800]: <info>  [1794835340.4078] dhcp4 (enp2s0): activation: beginning transaction (timeout in 45 seconds)
Nov 16 21:22:22.932774 * NetworkManager[800]: <info>  [1794835342.9327] device (enp2s0): state change: secondaries -> activated (reason 'none', managed-type: 'full')
Nov 16 21:22:22.933679 * NetworkManager[800]: <info>  [1794835342.9336] device (enp2s0): Activation: successful, device activated.
Nov 16 21:22:25.352124 * NetworkManager[800]: <info>  [1794835345.3519] dhcp4 (enp2s0): state changed new lease, address=192.168.0.100, acd pending
Nov 16 21:22:25.485621 * NetworkManager[800]: <info>  [1794835345.4854] dhcp4 (enp2s0): state changed new lease, address=192.168.0.100
```

netns created @  21:22:24  but IPv4 only receive @ 21:22:25

For workaround (purposed by LLM), I override the `podman-user-wait-network-online.service` ExecStart to `/bin/sh -c 'until /usr/bin/systemctl is-active -q network-online.target && /usr/sbin/ip -4 route show default | grep -q .; do sleep 0.5; done'`, and verified that it fix the issue.

### Steps to reproduce the issue

Steps to reproduce the issue
1. Ensure the machine have IPv6 and IPv4 with DHCPv4
2. Setup a wireguard
3. Add a quadlet container that auto start (`WantedBy=default.target`)
4. Reboot the machine
5. `podman unshare --rootless-netns ip route`  is missing default route

### Describe the results you received

Container have no default route and not able to access internet

### Describe the results you expected

Container should wait for IPv4 to be up before starting so the correct interface is used by pasta to create the netns which have default route
